resolved the build error. 
Thanks a lot for reviewing the patch set

As I understand, this defined for Firmware Component Name.
The bmcweb obtains the Firmware Component Name from the object patch. Example /xyz/openbmc_project/software/UEFI. This will mapped to the Id property https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/master/redfish-core/lib/update_service.hpp#L1232.
Therefore, this is redundant to map the Firmware Component Name to xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item.s PrettyName.

Is the suggestion to get rid of Item interface ? 
It indicates the presence of the device.
IMO, we can keep the xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item's Present property to indicates the presence of the device. But, do not need to support PrettyName property.
What is purpose of this function? Is this needed?

Other services also expose Version(example pldm, entity-manager).
Hence we check if the version path already exists. 
Based on that we create FirmwareInventory for only those which is not duplicate.
As comment above, do not need to create firmware object path based on Firmware ID. This should be based on Firmware Component Name.
As per your requirement FirmwareId and FirmwareComponent has different names ?
Yes, they has different names in our system. That why we create object path based on the Firmware Component Name.

@Prithvi Pai, 
Could you support the option to select the Firmware ID or Firmware Component when create an object path?
As requested added meson option which helps in selecting firmware component name as dbus object path
@wangkuiying.wky@alibaba-inc.com @hieuh@os.amperecomputing.com could you please review
use phosphor logger to be consistent with rest of code
Addressed removed std::cerr and used phosphor logging
Is the intention to return empty string here? I think it is clear it just return empty string explicitly here and move line89 down into line 110
Addressed
these lines duplicate with line 47-66. Can one function uses the result from other if they are trying to find and parse the data structure the same way.
As suggested added a function to avoid duplication
Done
Two comments, but overall is ok.
Looks good now. +1 with one nit comment
nit: item to be consistent with other naming convention
Changed to `item`

Why append three times? one time is ok, like below:
.append(firmwarePath, 0, interfaces);
I used the approach which we have in smbios-mdr to maintain consistency
Done
Used `sdbusplus::message_t` in this case to avoid compile time overhead
Done
Look good to me.

What happened if FirmwareObjPath contains the spaces at the end. Eg "UEFI ". This will become UEFI_. Since it's unnecessary, we should remove them.
Refer to https://github.com/openbmc/smbios-mdr/blob/master/src/dimm.cpp#L412
Are there any use case where there are whitespace at the end ?
Per SMBIOS spec, Firmware Component Name's description is "String number of the Firmware Component Name.". Therefore, this field can contains whitespace at the end.
Done
LGTM!
